instructions.run_date: run.py asks for DD/MM/YYYY, yesterday or earlier. Python reads today in Europe/London.
instructions.archive: Reuse a completed tests/data_dumps/YYYY-MM-DD archive without API calls. Incomplete runs resume checkpoints.
instructions.options: Yesterday COB uses current live snapshots with IV/Greeks where supplied. Older COB uses historical bars for that exact date only. Historical failures never switch to current live data.
instructions.contracts: All 4181 SPX AM calls are explicit inputs. No discovery, weekly calls, puts or options from other providers.
instructions.history: run.py asks for the history start (DD/MM/YYYY). HISTORY_START and COB are resolved into actual dates for every non-option request. Range errors trigger provider-specific maximum accessible history; fallback and limitations are recorded. Authentication/network errors do not trigger date fallbacks.
instructions.limitations: IBKR has no per-contract historical IV/Greeks in this endpoint and no expired-option history. Missing fields, permissions and empty dates are recorded, not filled.
instructions.products: SPX index, SPY equity ETF and IEF Treasury ETF where supported; existing FRED/ECB reference series retained.

index.instructions: SPX is the S&P 500 price index. Use the provider-native identifier and check enabled/notes in requests for current access. No SPY substitution.

template.description: S&P 500 price index; underlying of the configured SPX options

etf.instructions: SPY is the US-listed S&P 500 equity ETF; IEF is the US-listed 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF. Use each listing's provider-native symbol and exchange. Adjust the history timeframe in requests.

template.description: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF, US listing

index_option.date_policy: run.py selects current live snapshots for yesterday COB; historical bars for any earlier COB.
